ns2:section.sectionText: Focuses on adult development as a tool for understanding the quality of family relationships and community functioning. Examines theories of adult development; the concept of healthy aging, as well as the challenges faced by many adults as they grow older in the U.S.; skills for understanding the many roles played by adults and how community agencies and services can assist them in carrying out these roles; and strategies for assisting adults in achieving resiliency, from a bio-psycho-social perspective. Students unable to add this class who wish to add their names to a wait list should go to http://hcd.illinois.edu/student_information/courses/waitlist.html and follow Wait List Instructions.
